details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3055), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using ephemeral per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: The token is exposed in subprocess argv, process listings, Git error/debug output, and temporary `.git/config` remote entries, violating the credential-handling contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 569-588), memory_ensure_branch (lines 140-183), memory_force_tick_get/put (lines 770, 886, 922) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` authentication was removed, leaving token-bearing URLs and bare Git operations.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, operations can run unauthenticated and silently fail open; where tokens are embedded in URLs, credentials leak through argv and remote configuration.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:codex invocation (line 664); broker calls removed (lines 48, 208-215) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase bypasses the provider broker and invokes Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` while the real `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` remains available.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostics execute with workspace write access and direct provider credentials instead of the required broker-mediated read-only boundary.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:removed is_sensitive_target_path (old lines 156-167); normalize_path (lines 240-247); emit_context loop (lines 560-579) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed and `emit_context` resolves raw caller paths without normalization.
  WHY: Untrusted targets can read credential-bearing files such as `.git/config`, `.env.production`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, `.netrc`, `.npmrc`, and `.pypirc` into model context.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:entire model_provider_broker_* block (previously lines 143-484) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `model_provider_broker_*` helper family was deleted while unchanged scripts and workflows still call it.
  WHY: Under `set -e`, review, implement, orchestrate, clarify, validate, security-audit, triage, consolidation, conflict-resolution, retro-fanout, and self-heal phases abort with command-not-found before model execution.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:git_with_github_auth removed at line ~493-506; review_blocked_* helpers removed at ~410 lines | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication and `review_blocked_*` helper families were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked pushes and terminal approval flows fail with command-not-found or cannot authenticate, preventing approval publication, validation, successor handling, and completion.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:option parser (lines 95-110, 143-149); hardcoded base_url (line 261) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` and its validation were removed while existing callers still pass the option, and `base_url` is hardcoded.
  WHY: Config generation exits with an unknown-argument error; hardcoding the public endpoint also bypasses the loopback broker.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest line 769; gh_pr_with_all_comments lines 833-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: REST and GraphQL comment projections drop `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`, and change sorting from `(created_at, id)` to `(created_at, author, body)`.
  WHY: Review-blocked logic cannot authenticate producer markers, validate maintainer approvals, record consumed comment IDs, or preserve deterministic ordering.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_signal_child_group lines 404-407, _kill_child_group_if_running lines 439-448, idle-kill gate line 560 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Privileged signalling and SIGKILL escalation return or are skipped when the tracked `sudo` wrapper has exited, even if isolated group members remain alive.
  WHY: A runaway nobody-owned editor can survive idle/watchdog termination; survivors are logged or reported but never signalled.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:terminate_editor_attempt_process_group lines 289-336; watchdog call sites at lines 2178, 2200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: When metadata or the signalling helper is unavailable, only the guard PID is killed, and watchdog calls discard the failure with `|| true`.
  WHY: The isolated editor group remains alive during wall/idle termination, recreating the original signal gap.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:removed MAX_TARGET_PATHS, MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES, is_sensitive_target_path (old lines 152-170) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Exported module symbols were deleted while tests still import them.
  WHY: `tests/test_targeted_file_context.py` fails during collection with `ImportError`.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context lines 562-564 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` now emits headers and a disabled marker instead of returning an empty string.
  WHY: Callers using zero as the disable switch receive non-empty context, and the existing zero-budget contract test fails.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context missing-file branch lines 576-583; removed MAX_TARGET_PATHS and MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file markers and other output are appended without charging `used_bytes`, while path-count and path-length caps were removed.
  WHY: Adversarial missing-path lists can produce output and filesystem probing far beyond `max_bytes`.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 62-67 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The HEAD-based cleanup check was replaced with an index check, staged restoration no longer includes `--staged`, and the cached-removal fallback was removed.
  WHY: Staged deletion, partial staging, and newly added states can produce the opposite cleanup decision, deleting tracked files or preserving stale artifacts.

- scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh:editor_isolation_signal_process_group lines 109-120 or 160-179 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: After `sudo -n kill` fails, `pgrep` exit codes greater than 1 are treated as if the group were absent.
  WHY: An inspection failure can report successful convergence without signalling the isolated group, allowing survivors to remain alive.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_write_process_group_metadata, called unconditionally at line ~300 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: An `OSError` during metadata publication is raised outside the signal-failure handling path.
  WHY: The guard can crash after spawning the child, leaving it unsupervised without the documented exit-126 failure semantics.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:cleanup_editor_isolation lines 265-275; process-group cleanup ordering lines 2202-2207 vs 2318-2332 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Process-group metadata removal can race with verification and a subsequent editor attempt.
  WHY: A retry can observe the unset metadata path and exit silently while verification of the prior group is still in flight.

- scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh:editor_isolation_verify_process_group_stopped lines 181-200 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The verification loop has a hardcoded 20-attempt, two-second window and returns as soon as the group temporarily appears empty.
  WHY: Slow runners or delayed reaping can cause cleanup to proceed while nobody-owned survivors remain.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_signal_child_group lines 408-425 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A failed privileged kill followed by `_process_group_exists()` returning false is treated as successful termination.
  WHY: The false result can represent a transient probe failure rather than group convergence, masking a real signalling failure.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:wrapper_returncode handling lines 488-490; final finally block lines 583-586 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Survivors emerging after the initial SIGKILL are reported and converted to exit 126 without another signalling attempt.
  WHY: The current guard invocation does not re-signal the surviving group, leaving the next attempt as the only recovery path.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:COMMAND-derived ISOLATED_USER extraction lines 184-202 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Privileged signalling is selected by parsing the command prefix rather than by the editor isolation metadata.
  WHY: A future caller that wraps or changes the `sudo` launch shape can silently fall back to unprivileged signalling despite equivalent isolation semantics.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:model_provider_broker_start at 2062; editor_isolation_exit_trap model_provider_broker_stop at 338 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The isolated editor directly depends on broker helpers deleted from `scripts/codex_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: `set -e` reaches command-not-found before the editor launches, so the new process-group kill path cannot run.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
